type-system.twistDescription: Shifted all heading font weights from 500 to 700 (+200) to add institutional heft to the display hierarchy, and replaced proprietary Neue Haas Grotesk Display Pro with Space Grotesk via Google Fonts CDN, while keeping Inter for body copy via CDN import

motion-system.twistDescription: All transition durations scaled by x1.8, transforming quick 0.15s–0.5s transitions into languid 0.27s–0.9s movements that deepen the meditative quality of the animation vocabulary

grid-system.twistDescription: All column and row gap values scaled up by x1.4, expanding breathing room between grid columns and rows across all named grids and responsive breakpoints

spacing-system.twistDescription: Hero section padding scaled up by 1.5× to amplify the heroic breathing room, while all other element spacing remains unchanged

interaction-states.twistDescription: Applied hover opacity twist at intensity 3, setting opacity to 0.75 on all hover states across links, replacing fractional opacity values with a clean 0.75 uniform hover opacity

nav-system.twistDescription: Added a typography section with letterSpacing of 0.08em on nav links, giving the minimal floating nav a more deliberate, wide-tracked typographic presence

concept-summary.twistDescription: The Media Composition and Art Direction section was shifted to a more material register, foregrounding the physical craft and tactile qualities of the 3D object's construction and surface rendering
